fields.name: ability_available
fields.owner_structure: participant object three-slot Ability Card records and participant available-slot cache
fields.access: participant +0x6E + slot_index * 4 equals 0; participant +0xF9 caches ordinary available slots
fields.initialization: Participant construction clears the three four-byte Ability records and initializes +0xF9 from the configured Ability count.
mutations: State 0 to nonzero decrements participant +0xF9 through setter 0x0226A448.
A nonzero state returning to 0 increments participant +0xF9 through the same setter.
Scripted setup may seed state 2 and directly override +0xF9.
fields.reset: New participant construction is authoritative; destruction invalidates the object without clearing every byte in place.
fields.player_ai_behavior: The same slot records, count cache, selector, and setter apply to participant 0 and participant 1.
fields.scripted_behavior: Tutorial and scripted setup at 0x0226A48C can pre-disable all three slots with state 2 and set +0xF9 to zero.
fields.evidence: Selector 0x0226A700 enumerates state-0 records only; setter 0x0226A448 maintains +0xF9 exactly when state crosses the zero/nonzero boundary.

fields.name: ability_selected
fields.owner_structure: battle setup selection object and per-combatant Ability descriptor
fields.access: selection object +0x53 holds slot or 0xFF; effect descriptor byte +0x11 holds selected slot and halfword +0x12 holds Ability ID
fields.initialization: Selection fields begin at 0xFF/no selection and are populated from selector 0x0226A700 plus participant Ability ID at +0x6C + slot * 4.
mutations: Normal player and AI setup calls selector 0x0226A700.
A selected slot is copied with its Ability ID into the combatant/effect descriptor.
A 0xFF selector result clears the selected Ability ID and preserves the no-card path.
fields.lifetime: battle setup and Ability effect-scene lifetime
fields.reset: New battle setup initializes the selection fields; effect-scene destruction ends validity.
fields.player_ai_behavior: The same descriptor geometry is used for both combatants; selection inputs differ by participant and AI policy, not storage format.
fields.scripted_behavior: Scripted participant setup can make all slots unavailable, forcing selector result 0xFF.
fields.evidence: Path 0x02244440 stores selector return at object +0x53, rejects 0xFF, resolves the participant record, and consumes the selected slot.

fields.name: ability_activated
fields.access: effect object state byte +0x4D, active combatant byte +0x4E, classified effect byte +0x4F, and active Ability ID halfword +0x56
fields.initialization: Effect-scene construction initializes +0x4D to state 0 before activation dispatch.
mutations: Activation helper 0x0221A6B4 copies the selected Ability ID, classifies it, resolves participant and slot, and writes slot state 2.
The state machine beginning 0x0221A7D0 advances +0x4D through effect-specific presentation and gameplay phases.
A second-combatant activation path at state 10 performs the same participant/slot resolution and state-2 write.
fields.reset: New effect-scene construction resets state; destruction invalidates the object.
fields.player_ai_behavior: Active combatant +0x4E selects either record; descriptor participant nibble resolves the correct human or AI participant object.
fields.scripted_behavior: Scripted no-card setups never enter activation because selection resolves to 0xFF.
fields.evidence: 0x0221A6B4 reads descriptor slot +0x11 and ID +0x12, calls setter 0x0226A448 with state 2, then begins the shared effect state machine.

fields.name: ability_resolved
fields.access: effect object +0x4D reaches terminal state 20 and update returns 1
fields.initialization: The state machine begins from state 0 after effect-scene construction.
mutations: Effect-specific states update G-Power, flags, presentation, or battle control according to Ability ID/class.
State 19 waits for the final scene boundary, performs cleanup, increments +0x4D to 20, and returns completion.
The participant slot remains unavailable after scene completion.
fields.reset: A later effect receives a new effect-scene object; participant reset is separate.
fields.player_ai_behavior: Both combatant records use the same terminal state and cleanup path.
fields.scripted_behavior: No-card paths bypass the effect scene; special Ability IDs can take effect-specific branches but converge on terminal cleanup.
fields.evidence: State-machine case at 0x0221B870 waits for completion, clears active flags, increments +0x4D, and returns 1 at 0x0221B8D0.

fields.name: ability_used
fields.owner_structure: participant Ability Card record and available-slot cache
fields.access: participant +0x6E + slot_index * 4 equals 2; participant +0xF9 reflects the zero/nonzero transition
fields.initialization: Ordinary available slots begin in state 0.
mutations: Accepted selection path at 0x0224460C writes state 2 through 0x0226A448.
Activation paths at 0x0221A728 and 0x0221B150 idempotently write state 2 for the active participant and slot.
No normal battle path restores a consumed slot before reset.
fields.reset: Participant construction or explicit reset paths return slots to state 0; script setup may instead seed state 2.
fields.player_ai_behavior: Winner, control identity, and Gate ownership do not change the shared state-2 consumption contract.
fields.scripted_behavior: State 2 can also mean script-disabled, so the used semantic requires selection/activation evidence in addition to the byte alone.
fields.evidence: Seven exact direct callers of setter 0x0226A448 include accepted selection, both activation paths, and four reset/management paths.

fields.name: ability_reset
fields.initialization: Participant constructor clears records and initializes +0xF9.
mutations: Four management callers at 0x02242CCC, 0x02242D30, 0x02242DA4, and 0x02242E20 can write state 0 through the shared setter.
Scripted setup may immediately replace ordinary reset values.
Participant destruction frees the object rather than clearing state in place.
fields.player_ai_behavior: The same constructor and setter reset both participants.
fields.scripted_behavior: Tutorial setup deliberately replaces ordinary availability with state 2 and zero available count.
fields.evidence: Exact constructor, setter caller inventory, and scripted setup distinguish ordinary reset from scripted override.

checks.name: selection_consumes_exact_slot
checks.evidence: 0x02244440 stores the selected slot, resolves its Ability ID, and calls setter 0x0226A448 with the same slot and state 2.

checks.name: activation_uses_selected_descriptor
checks.evidence: 0x0221A6B4 reads descriptor +0x11/+0x12, resolves the descriptor participant nibble, and repeats the same state-2 mutation before effect execution.

checks.name: resolution_has_terminal_boundary
checks.evidence: The 20-state effect machine converges on state 19 cleanup, increments to state 20, and returns completion.

checks.name: no_ability_control_returns_ff
checks.evidence: Clean executable tutorial capture called selector 0x0226A700 for AI participant 0x022E2640 with IDs 126/140/177, all states 2 and +0xF9=0; return at 0x022412F4 was 0xFF.

checks.name: ability_timing_is_after_gate_bonus
checks.evidence: Battle construction applies Gate bonus and target total before the later Ability selection/effect setup path.

checks.name: red_ability_can_defer_activation
checks.evidence: The shared selected/used state is established before minigame execution while effect-scene metadata permits deferred in-battle activation; immediate cards resolve before minigame start.

states.evidence: exact AI selection path and no-card control

timing.selection_boundary: Selector 0x0226A700 returns slot or 0xFF into battle setup; 0x02244440 stores the slot and consumes it when accepted.
timing.activation_boundary: 0x0221A6B4 copies selected ID/slot into the effect scene and begins shared execution; a second-combatant branch repeats the same transition.
timing.resolution_boundary: State-machine state 19 at 0x0221B870 completes presentation/gameplay cleanup, advances +0x4D to 20, and returns completion at 0x0221B8D0.
timing.gate_bonus_relation: Gate bonus and target total are established by battle construction before Ability selection and effect processing.
timing.battle_type_relation: Immediate Ability effects resolve in the pre-minigame setup and may alter or bypass later battle behavior; explicit battle-type selection remains a separate field.
timing.minigame_relation: Blue/green immediate effects resolve before minigame start; red selected cards can defer their activation to the in-battle L/R input path.
timing.result_relation: Ability effect resolution precedes ordinary battle-result winner and capture bookkeeping.

scripted_paths: Tutorial setup at 0x0226A48C seeds all three Ability states to 2 and available count to zero.
Scripted no-card setup therefore returns 0xFF from the ordinary selector without entering the effect scene.
Special Ability IDs take card-specific branches inside the shared 20-state effect machine but converge on common cleanup.
no_ability_control: Clean executable tutorial capture: AI participant 0x022E2640, Ability IDs 126/140/177, states 2/2/2, +0xF9=0, selector entry 0x0226A700, caller return 0x022412F4, result 0xFF.
